Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your quality commitment. We appreciate your enthusiasm about working with Hollerau Pumpenwerke, and we would be glad to build a reliable partnership with Kalwisz. Our recent orders and the movement in electricity producer prices provide a basis for the price we are asking.

You asked what volume we would commit to. Our order volume is fixed: it covers our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you. Our forecast is rising, which makes this a meaningful commitment and gives us a basis for discussing the price and quality terms together.

We understand that dependable payment timing matters to you. The payment terms for this agreement are fixed, and we pay reliably on the due date. In return for the committed volume and term, we ask for a substantially tighter quality commitment than in your offer, with no chargeback for complaints. Could you work with us on that basis?

Please see the binding volume statement and supporting data that follow, then our detailed proposal.

We confirm a binding volume of 15900 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 41.36 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
Please let me explain.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Thanks for the data, but 300 ppm is way too strict for us right now.
I can bring the price down to 46.00 EUR, but in exchange I need to set the quality target to 1500 ppm, which is still a massive improvement.
You mentioned paying on time, but honestly you guys are usually late, and we really need faster payments to keep things running smoothly.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We really want this business - let's make it happen!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek,

Thank you for moving your offer again, and for taking our volume and cost data into account. We understand that protecting your margin matters, and that faster payment would help with your cash position. Payment terms are fixed in this agreement and cannot change. What we can offer is reliable payment on the due date, our full demand for this part placed with you, and the contract term.

Our order volume is fixed and covers all our demand for this part over the term. Our forecast is rising, so the relationship can grow with that demand. We take the quality concerns seriously and appreciate your 8D report. At the same time, the recent delivery performance supports maintaining a firm quality commitment.

We have considered your latest position and are moving toward you again, while keeping the quality commitment aligned with the standard we need. The data cited below provides context, and the proposal that follows sets out the full terms for our demand over the contract term.

Your deliveries ran at 2376 ppm in 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our proposal in detail: EUR 42.90 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
